title: Closure deficit CD_tau = I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) as a single exact conditional-MI obstruction unifying lumpability, predictive sufficiency, and feasible one-wayness
scientific_domain: Statistical mechanics of coarse-grained effective dynamics + information physics (predictive sufficiency / causal states, feasible irreversibility). NOT two distinct continuum-physics domains.
argument_family: cross-domain-unification (single exact information-theoretic obstruction specialized to three established results)

card.one_sentence_claim: A single exact conditional-mutual-information obstruction, the closure deficit CD_tau(Pi) = I(X_t; Y_{t+tau} | Y_t), with the identity H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) = H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t) + CD_tau, simultaneously characterizes (i) exact lumpability / closed effective-theory dynamics of finite Markov chains, (ii) predictive sufficiency (screening-off of micro past from packaged future), and (iii) feasible one-wayness of a deterministic packaging map, so that all three "looks-random" phenomena are the same conditional-MI vanishing under a chosen packaging and budget.
card.target_known_fact: Three standard facts: (a) Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz exact lumpability -- a finite Markov chain admits an exactly closed coarse-grained (macro) law iff the partition is lumpable; (b) Shalizi-Crutchfield computational-mechanics predictive sufficiency -- a state is predictively sufficient iff it screens off the past from the future; (c) the Bellare-Rogaway random-oracle inversion heuristic -- success ~ q/2^n for q queries against an n-bit one-way function.
card.scientific_domain: Statistical mechanics of coarse-grained effective dynamics + information physics (predictive sufficiency / causal states, feasible irreversibility). NOT two distinct continuum-physics domains.
card.argument_family: cross-domain-unification (single exact information-theoretic obstruction specialized to three established results)

theory_basis.component: Micro-closure deficit CD_tau(Pi) = I(X_t; Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) (def:closure-deficit) and the exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) = H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t) + CD_tau (prop:cd-decomposition), proved by the conditional-MI chain rule plus Y_t = Pi(X_t) deterministic
theory_basis.role: Core exact identity; the single obstruction. Both terms and the decomposition are proved in full.

theory_basis.component: Expected-KL form CD_tau = sum_x pi(x) D_KL(p_x^(tau) || pbar_{Pi(x)}^(tau)) (prop:cd-kl) and the equivalence theorem: CD_tau=0 iff Pi is tau-closed, and tau-closedness at tau=1 IS classical lumpability (prop:cd-zero)
theory_basis.role: Leg (a): recovers Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability as the CD=0 special case; gives the sufficiency reading of leg (b).

theory_basis.component: NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT: CD_tau(Pi) = min_K L_tau(K) = L_tau(K*) with K*_y = Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y), the best-macro-kernel variational identity, plus strict positivity when fiber laws differ (thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT, lem:closure_kl_mixture, lem:closure_best_macro_kernel, lem:closure_cmi_identity)
theory_basis.role: Promotes CD_tau from a diagnostic to THE exact obstruction to any closed macro law at lag tau (variational characterization); strengthens leg (a). VERIFIED: paper itself flags this as 'a finite KL-projection instance [Csiszar 1975]' (No-Go line 326, 693).

theory_basis.component: Predictive quotient PredictiveQ (M): future-sufficiency theorem and unique reachable-image factorization of any future-sufficient abstraction through M (thm:future-sufficient, thm:reachable-factorization; Lean predictiveQuotient_futureSufficient, futureSufficient_factorsThroughPredictiveQuotient_onReachable)
theory_basis.role: Leg (b): SBT-internal predictive-sufficiency / screening-off machinery (adjacent to Shalizi-Crutchfield causal states), Lean-anchored. CAVEAT (verified): lives on abstract typed histories/interfaces, NOT the Markov substrate; the Holonomy paper itself states 'does not identify PredictiveQ with any one of those formalisms' and 'does not claim to subsume' causal states. The Cast paper does NOT cite this paper.

theory_basis.component: Route mismatch RM_tau^stat(Pi) with the Pinsker+Jensen lower bound CD_tau >= (1/2)(RM_tau^stat)^2 (prop:rm-lower-bound); empirical RM^uniform vs CD Pearson r=0.959; lumpable cases CD_1 ~ 4.34e-17
theory_basis.role: Computable diagnostic that provably controls the exact object; the numerically-anchored proxy tracking CD. CAVEAT (verified): Pinsker bound is proved for the stationary-conditional lift, but the reported r=0.959 uses the cheaper uniform lift (paper acknowledges this at line 397).

theory_basis.component: Packaging as many-to-one map / one-wayness as feasible irreversibility relative to bounded observers; toy hashing instance, uniform-input inversion tracks q/2^n in small-success region (MAD 3.70e-3; n=16,q=256: 6.67e-3 vs 256/2^16=3.91e-3), low-entropy inputs invert with prob 1.00 (sec:results-hashing)
theory_basis.role: Leg (c): packaging+budget reading of one-wayness; the q/2^n heuristic recovered in a deliberately toy setting (NOT a security claim). VERIFIED: no equation links CD or H(X|Y) to inversion success; verbal analogy + toy numerics only.

theory_basis.component: Lean KL bridge: klDiv(mu,nu).toReal = integral of log-likelihood-ratio under mu, nonnegativity, and zero-divergence-iff-equal characterization (app:lean)
theory_basis.role: Machine-checks the single KL algebraic step underwriting the expected-divergence reading of CD; deliberately modest (not full CMI mechanization).

required_definitions: Finite stationary substrate X_t (Markov chain kernel P, stationary law pi) [A_FIN, A_STAT]
Packaging/lens Pi: X -> Y deterministic surjection; Y_t := Pi(X_t) [A_LENS]
Micro packaged-future laws p_x^(tau)(y') = Pr(Y_{t+tau}=y'|X_t=x) and macro fiber-averages pbar_y^(tau) = sum_{x in Pi^{-1}(y)} pi(x|y) p_x^(tau)
Closure deficit CD_tau(Pi) := I(X_t; Y_{t+tau} | Y_t) [def:closure-deficit]
Predictive quotient PredictiveQ and future-sufficient state abstraction [Holonomy paper]
Bounded-observer budget B / query budget q and output truncation n for the one-wayness leg [P6 accounting]

required_lemmas.statement: Exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) = H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t) + CD_tau(Pi), via CMI chain rule and H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t,Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t) since Y_t=Pi(X_t).
Expected-KL form CD_tau = sum_x pi(x) D_KL(p_x^(tau) || pbar_{Pi(x)}^(tau)).
CD_tau=0 iff Pi is tau-closed (under full support); tau-closed at tau=1 is exactly classical lumpability stated on packaged destination laws.
required_lemmas.paper: To_Cast_a_Stone prop:cd-zero (VERIFIED: clean iff with full-support converse; tau=1 lumpability explicit, tau>1 hedged as 'same condition after staging')

required_lemmas.statement: Variational identity CD_tau = min_K L_tau(K) = L_tau(K*) with best macro kernel K*_y = Law(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t=y); strict positivity if two positive-mass fiber laws differ.
required_lemmas.paper: No-Go thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT + lemmas (KL mixture decomposition); paper flags as Csiszar-1975 KL-projection instance

required_lemmas.statement: Predictive quotient is future-sufficient and every future-sufficient abstraction factors uniquely through it (reachable image).
required_lemmas.paper: Holonomy thm:future-sufficient, thm:reachable-factorization (Lean-formalized; on abstract typed histories, NOT Markov substrate)

required_lemmas.statement: Bridging lemma: CD_tau(Pi)=0 (sufficiency-of-Y_t for one staged step) coincides with Y_t being a predictively-sufficient (screening-off) statistic for Y_{t+tau} given the substrate, i.e. the SBT predictive-quotient sufficiency restricted to a single staged lag.
required_lemmas.paper: NEEDED -- connects prop:cd-zero to Holonomy thm:future-sufficient; would make leg (b) a theorem rather than an informal adjacency. VERIFIED ABSENT: Cast paper does not cite Holonomy; the two objects live in different formalisms (CMI on Markov chain vs event-signature equivalence on history interfaces).

required_lemmas.statement: One-wayness leg as a theorem (not toy demo): a budget-parameterized statement that for a deterministic packaging Pi, bounded-observer inversion success is governed by the conditional residual H(X_t|Y_t) / input entropy, recovering q/2^n in the high-input-entropy random-oracle limit.
required_lemmas.paper: NEEDED -- currently only a toy numerical demonstration + verbal analogy; no derivation of q/2^n from CD

main_steps: State the finite stationary setting (P, pi, Pi, tau) and define CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) [all proved, To_Cast_a_Stone sec:closure].
Prove the exact decomposition and the expected-KL form (one-line CMI chain-rule arguments) [proved].

Specialize to CD_tau=0 <=> tau-closed <=> (tau=1) lumpable: this RECOVERS Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz as the vanishing-obstruction case [proved; recovery, not new physics; exact lumpability identification only at tau=1].
Invoke the No-Go variational identity to promote CD_tau to the exact, kernel-optimal obstruction to ANY closed macro law at lag tau [proved; = Csiszar KL-projection instance].

Add the new bridging lemma identifying CD_tau=0 with single-lag predictive sufficiency, then cite the Holonomy future-sufficiency/factorization theorems to anchor leg (b) inside SBT [bridging lemma NEEDED; the Holonomy theorem is on abstract histories, not the Markov substrate].

Cast hashing as a deterministic packaging Pi with huge fibers; present the q/2^n behavior as the high-input-entropy / bounded-budget face of the SAME CD logic [currently toy demo + analogy; a derivation step is NEEDED to make leg (c) a theorem].
Tie together with the Pinsker route-mismatch bound and the Lean KL bridge as the computable + machine-checked anchors of the exact object [proved/Lean].
data_comparison_steps: Reproduce the controlled Markov benchmark (17 staged conditions: exactly-lumpable, perturbed-lumpable alpha in {0,0.2,0.5}, metastable p_out in {0.02,0.08,0.20}, hidden-type strength {0.1,0.5,0.9}); confirm CD_1 ~ 4.34e-17 on lumpable cases and decomposition residual <= 2.87e-16.
Confirm RM^uniform vs CD Pearson r=0.959 across benchmark rows; check Pinsker bound CD >= (1/2)RM_stat^2 holds row-by-row.

Reproduce the budgeted-prediction curve on the strongest hidden-type process: order-0 NLL 1.09565 -> order-1 1.04394 -> order-2 1.03855 nats, vs exact H(Y_{t+1}|Y_t)=1.04953; verify feasible-class monotonicity.

Reproduce toy hashing: uniform-input inversion MAD 3.70e-3 vs q/2^n for q/2^n<=0.25 (n=16,q=256: empirical 6.67e-3 vs baseline 3.91e-3); confirm low-entropy dictionary inversion prob 1.00 and collision ratios 0.816 (uniform) vs 66.24 / 255.30 (mixture / low-entropy).
Cross-check the auxiliary k-means clustering caution: CD rises 0.0782 -> 0.1356 -> 0.1579 as k goes 2->4->8 (more bins != better packaging).
proof_route.minimum_viable_result: A single self-contained note proving (already done in the papers) that CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) is the exact obstruction whose vanishing IS lumpability (leg a) and IS single-lag predictive sufficiency (leg b, via the new bridging lemma), with the Markov benchmark + Pinsker bound + Lean KL step as evidence. This is the honest core: two of the three legs become a clean unification of two ESTABLISHED stat-mech/info-physics facts under one elementary exact identity, with CD=0 reproducing both. It deliberately scopes out the hashing leg as a separate, weaker toy demonstration.
proof_route.stronger_result: Add a budget-parameterized theorem turning the q/2^n hashing leg from a toy numerical match into a derivation: show that for a deterministic packaging, bounded-observer inversion/distinguishing advantage is governed by the conditional residual H(X_t|Y_t) relative to input entropy, recovering q/2^n in the high-input-entropy random-oracle limit and collapsing for low-entropy sources -- making all three legs theorems of one CD-budget calculus. Optionally extend CD_tau to stochastic-kernel lenses Q_f (currently outside the certified Lean core) and mechanize the full conditional-MI decomposition (currently only the KL step is Lean-checked).
estimated_bottlenecks: Leg (c) is the weak joint: q/2^n is an externally-known heuristic confirmed only in a deliberately toy-sized setting; deriving it from CD requires a genuine budget/feasibility argument that the papers replace with a verbal analogy. Risk that it stays a packaging+budget metaphor, not a derivation.

The bridging lemma (CD=0 <-> single-lag predictive sufficiency) is moderate but the predictive-quotient sufficiency lives in a different (route-transport) formalism, so the identification is conceptual gluing, not a copied theorem.

The 'unification' is at risk of being a definitional move: CD_tau=0 is lumpability rebranded as a conditional MI, and the decomposition is an elementary chain-rule identity, so reviewers may see relabeling rather than new content.

Cross-domain framing spans stat-mech + info-physics, not two continuum-physics domains; SBT itself disclaims that CD>0 certifies irreversibility or novelty, so the unification must not overclaim physical content.
Lean coverage is partial: only the KL bridge (klDiv = integral of log-likelihood ratio, nonnegativity, zero-iff-equal) is machine-checked; conditional MI and the decomposition are not mechanized.
proof_route.fallback_result: If the hashing derivation and bridging lemma cannot be made rigorous, the defensible deliverable is exactly what the papers already prove: a clean exact-decomposition note showing CD_tau is THE conditional-MI obstruction to closed macro dynamics, recovering Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability as CD=0 (with the No-Go variational identity, the Pinsker route-mismatch bound r=0.959, and the Lean KL step), framed honestly as a useful, falsifiable diagnostic that separates intrinsic substrate noise from lens-manufactured randomness -- a recovery + reorganization, not a new prediction.

card.baseline_comparison: Mostly RECOVERY + REORGANIZATION, not improvement over the standard account. Leg (a) lumpability is exactly recovered as the CD=0 special case (at tau=1) -- the papers cite Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz honestly and the exact decomposition is genuinely new but elementary (a one-line conditional-MI chain rule). Leg (b) predictive sufficiency is recovered/reframed (SBT's predictive quotient is 'adjacent to' Shalizi-Crutchfield causal states; the papers explicitly do not claim to subsume them). Leg (c) q/2^n is an externally known random-oracle heuristic confirmed in a toy, NOT derived and NOT a security claim. The genuine value-add over baselines is (1) the exact separation H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau cleanly splitting intrinsic substrate noise from lens-manufactured randomness, (2) the variational/best-macro-kernel characterization (No-Go, = Csiszar KL-projection instance), and (3) the provable, cheap route-mismatch proxy (Pinsker bound, r=0.959) and a Lean-checked KL step. SBT does NOT beat the standard accounts on any single domain; its contribution is the unifying exact obstruction plus a falsifiable diagnostic, with two legs being established facts re-derived and the third only a toy match.
card.why_scientists_care: It compresses three superficially unrelated facts -- lumpability/effective-theory closure, predictive sufficiency, and one-way q/2^n scaling -- into the vanishing of a single exact conditional-MI obstruction CD_tau, giving a layer-relative, falsifiable definition of randomness ('a macrostate looks random exactly to the extent it has failed to become a sufficient statistic for its own future'). The exact decomposition is a genuinely useful diagnostic for ANY coarse-grained effective theory: it tells a practitioner how much observed 'noise' is irreducible substrate uncertainty versus randomness manufactured by the chosen lens, with a cheap route-mismatch proxy that provably lower-bounds it. That is a portable, operational answer to a usually-metaphysical question, and it is computable exactly in finite benchmarks.
target_audience: Statistical mechanics / coarse-graining and effective-theory theorists (lumpability, Markov state models)
Computational mechanics / information-theory community (causal states, predictive sufficiency, information bottleneck)
Researchers in foundations of randomness and emergence
Applied ML/representation-learning practitioners interested in predictive-budget tradeoffs
Cryptography-adjacent readers (with the explicit caveat that this is a conceptual analogy, not a security result)
card.recommended_artifact: A short rigorous note plus a reproducible numerical companion: (1) the exact-decomposition theorem and CD=0 <=> lumpability <=> single-lag predictive sufficiency (legs a+b), citing the No-Go variational identity and the Holonomy future-sufficiency theorem, with the new bridging lemma made explicit; (2) the Markov benchmark + Pinsker route-mismatch verification (r=0.959) as the calibration figure; (3) the budgeted-randomness curve; (4) the toy hashing demonstration kept clearly scoped as illustration, not theorem; (5) the existing Lean KL-bridge module as the machine-checked anchor. Minimum viable: just (1)+(2). The figure-generation code already exists in the companion repo (github.com/ioannist/six-birds-randomness).
card.execution_cost: Low for the minimum-viable result: the core theorems (prop:cd-decomposition, prop:cd-kl, prop:cd-zero, prop:rm-lower-bound, NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT, Holonomy future-sufficiency) are ALREADY proved and partly Lean-checked, and all numerics are already frozen in the companion repo -- assembling the unification note and re-running benchmarks is days, not weeks. Medium-to-high for the stronger result: deriving the q/2^n leg from CD as a budget theorem and proving the CD=0 <-> predictive-sufficiency bridging lemma require genuine new arguments; extending to stochastic-kernel lenses and mechanizing the full conditional-MI decomposition in Lean is a substantial separate effort.
card.honest_status_note: This is a derivability-class-B cross-domain UNIFICATION, not a physics retrodiction. Honest status: the exact obstruction CD_tau, its decomposition, the lumpability equivalence (leg a), the variational best-macro-kernel identity, the Pinsker route-mismatch bound, and the predictive-sufficiency machinery (leg b) are all PROVED in the papers, and a modest KL step is Lean-certified; the numerics (r=0.959, q/2^n MAD 3.70e-3, etc.) are frozen regression certificates, not new empirical evidence. Two honest caveats per the ledger: (1) CD>0 is NOT irreversibility and NOT novelty -- it certifies no nonequilibrium drive (disclaimer 13); (2) the q/2^n leg is an externally-known heuristic confirmed only in a deliberately toy-sized, security-disclaimed setting, and is recovered, not derived. The chief risk is that the 'unification' reads as a definitional move (CD=0 is lumpability rebranded as a conditional MI, and the decomposition is an elementary chain-rule identity), and that leg (c) plus the CD=0/predictive-sufficiency bridge remain informal until the two NEEDED lemmas are supplied. No SBT disclaimer is crossed (no Born rule, no continuum, no micro-thermodynamics, no lens-selection claimed).

adhoc_test_answers.question: 1. Was the target used to design the theory (target leakage)?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: YES, structurally. The three 'targets' (Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz lumpability, Shalizi-Crutchfield predictive sufficiency, Bellare-Rogaway q/2^n) are pre-existing established results, and CD_tau was framed precisely so that CD=0 reproduces them. The card itself admits leg (a) is 'lumpability rebranded as a conditional MI' and the decomposition is 'an elementary chain-rule identity'. This is recovery/reorganization of known facts, not prediction of an unknown. target_used_to_design_theory = true.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 2. Could the theory have fit the OPPOSITE observation with similar freedom?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: For legs (a)/(b): NO in a trivial sense and YES in a damning sense. CD_tau=0 <-> lumpability is a true mathematical identity, so it could not retrodict a FALSE lumpability fact -- but precisely because it is an identity, it has no empirical content that could have come out otherwise; it holds regardless of the substrate, so passing it is not evidence. For leg (c): YES -- because the input-entropy regime and the q/2^n<=0.25 window are chosen post hoc, the SAME packaging-and-budget story accommodates both the q/2^n one-wayness (uniform inputs) AND its total collapse to inversion probability 1.00 (low-entropy inputs). The framework accommodates the heuristic AND its negation, so it cannot be falsified by the hashing data.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 3. How many free parameters / adjustable choices vs data points matched?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: ~11 adjustable choices (lens Pi, tau, budget B, lift choice, the unification triple itself, hashing regime, q, n, analysis window, benchmark knobs, clustering k) against effectively 3 'data points' -- all of which are pre-known theorems/heuristics, not measurements. Two of the three matches are exact identities (zero genuine fitting), and the third is a toy numerical match in a chosen window. DoF >> independent empirical content.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 4. Does the same mechanism (closure-deficit / conditional-MI vanishing) reuse across >=2 facts?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: YES for legs (a) and (b): the single object CD_tau = I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t) provably gives lumpability (CD=0 <-> tau-closed, prop:cd-zero) and is the variational best-macro-kernel obstruction (No-Go thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT); the sufficiency reading is the same vanishing. Genuine mechanism reuse across two facts. Leg (c) is only attached by analogy -- the CD-to-q/2^n derivation does not exist, so mechanism reuse there is verbal, not formal.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 5. Is known physics/mathematics imported rather than derived?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: YES, extensively. Conditional MI, the chain rule, KL, Pinsker's inequality, lumpability theory (Kemeny-Snell/Buchholz), the KL-projection/best-kernel view (Csiszar), predictive-state/causal-state theory (Shalizi-Crutchfield), and the random-oracle q/2^n heuristic (Bellare-Rogaway/Rogaway) are all imported standard results. The genuinely self-contained piece (the exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau) is, by the authors' own words, an elementary one-line identity. imports_known_physics = true.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 6. Are any SBT disclaimers crossed?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: NO disclaimer is crossed, and the card is scrupulous about this. Disclaimer 13 (CD>0 is NOT irreversibility and NOT novelty) is honored -- the paper repeatedly states CD is not an arrow-of-time certificate. The hashing leg is explicitly NOT a security claim. No Born rule, no continuum, no micro-thermodynamics, no lens-selection is claimed. The honest_status_note and discussion section actively flag these boundaries. This is a model of disclaimer compliance.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 7. Is the 'unification' a definitional move (relabeling) rather than new content?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: LARGELY YES for the load-bearing parts. CD=0 <-> lumpability is the chain-rule identity restated; the card concedes reviewers 'may see relabeling rather than new content'. The value-add that is NOT mere relabeling is real but modest: (i) the exact split of observed noise into intrinsic H(Y|X) + lens-manufactured CD, (ii) the variational best-macro-kernel characterization (No-Go), and (iii) the cheap, provable route-mismatch proxy (Pinsker, r=0.959) plus a Lean-checked KL step. None of these beat the standard accounts in their home domains.

adhoc_test_answers.question: 8. Are the matched numbers regression certificates or genuine predictions?
adhoc_test_answers.answer: REGRESSION CERTIFICATES. CD_1~4.34e-17 and residual <=2.87e-16 are machine-zero calibration of an identity that MUST hold; r=0.959 is a correlation between two quantities one of which provably lower-bounds the other (Pinsker), measured on hand-built chains; the budgeted-prediction NLL curve and hashing MAD 3.70e-3 are frozen numbers from the companion repo. The honest_status_note explicitly calls them 'frozen regression certificates, not new empirical evidence'. No out-of-sample prediction is at stake.

opposite_world_test.explanation: For the two rigorous legs (lumpability, sufficiency) the obstruction CD_tau is a mathematical IDENTITY (CD=0 iff tau-closed by the conditional-MI chain rule). An identity cannot retrodict a false instance, but it also has no empirical degrees of freedom that 'could have come out the other way' -- it is true regardless of the substrate, so passing it is not evidence. The genuinely flexible leg is the hashing one (leg c): with the input-entropy regime and the q/2^n<=0.25 window both chosen post hoc, the SAME packaging-and-budget story accommodates BOTH the q/2^n one-way scaling (uniform high-entropy inputs) AND its total collapse to inversion probability 1.00 (low-entropy dictionary inputs) AND the in-between 0.463 (mixture). Whatever the observed inversion behavior, CD-plus-budget 'explains' it by attributing it to input entropy and budget -- i.e. the opposite observation (a hash that is trivially invertible) is equally 'predicted'. Likewise, since SBT supplies no lens-selection principle, any partition that fails to close is simply read as 'CD>0, manufactured randomness', so a non-lumpable partition is as comfortably accommodated as a lumpable one. The framework is therefore unfalsifiable in the directions that matter: it reorganizes whatever is observed rather than forbidding any outcome. Note this is NOT a fake-arrow / wrong-sign physics risk -- SBT correctly refuses (via disclaimer 13) to read CD as a directional or thermodynamic quantity -- but the unification claim itself survives any data.

audit.audit_verdict: RECOVERY-PLUS-REORGANIZATION, NOT A PREDICTION; LOW LITERAL OVERFITTING RISK BUT HIGH MISFRAMING/UNFALSIFIABILITY RISK. The closure-deficit mechanism genuinely reuses across two facts (leg a lumpability via prop:cd-zero, and the variational obstruction No-Go thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT), and the exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau is a real (if elementary) identity that cleanly separates intrinsic substrate noise from lens-manufactured randomness. All SBT disclaimers are honored: CD>0 is correctly NOT read as irreversibility or novelty (disclaimer 13), no Born rule / continuum / micro-thermo / lens-selection is claimed, and the hashing leg is explicitly toy-scoped and security-disclaimed. HOWEVER: (1) the three 'targets' are pre-existing established theorems/heuristics, so target_used_to_design_theory is true and there is no new empirical prediction -- the matched numbers are frozen regression/calibration certificates of an identity that must hold. (2) Leg (a) is, by the card's own admission, 'lumpability rebranded as a conditional MI' -- a definitional move. (3) Leg (b)'s CD=0 <-> single-lag predictive-sufficiency bridge is NOT proved (flagged NEEDED); the Holonomy theorem is only 'adjacent to' Shalizi-Crutchfield. (4) Leg (c)'s q/2^n is imported, recovered only in a hand-chosen uniform-input, q/2^n<=0.25 window, and the opposite outcome (trivial inversion) is equally accommodated -- so the hashing unification is unfalsifiable. Roughly 11 adjustable choices against 3 pre-known facts, 2 of them exact identities. Defensible deliverable is exactly the fallback in the card: an honest exact-decomposition diagnostic note (legs a + the Pinsker proxy + Lean KL step), with legs (b) and (c) demoted to informal/toy until the two NEEDED lemmas are supplied.
